source: Own measurement through `ale validate` of the second round's version (seized fasteners with the shank's shear torque, swollen modules, foam pads over fasteners; the re-review's N1 to N3): run validate-f1ab66c2 on the tree of ce208f10 (the cell of dca001d1), the pinned engine bfb7505 (0.1.1), the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) as the oracle episode, graded in the engine's separate verifier sandbox (the cell as its own account from a private copy, the seccomp launcher, the kit's Solver and probe lock, one fresh cell process per pack) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/packs.json, six packs): mean_pack_credit 1.00000, every pack 1.0 (49, 48, 59, 58, 67 and 69 of their items placed) in 919, 843, 1067, 1062, 1149 and 1208 steps; no protective stop, no cell retry, nothing stripped or sheared, no module vented; the probe lock 85 of 85 (52 idle pairs not counted); the verify stage 864 s. Host: the author's validate host, one NVIDIA RTX 3090 on driver 535.183.01 (below Omniverse RTX's R550 floor, hence the cell's driver check off; the canary passed), an Intel i9-12900K, Docker 29.10.1 in rootless mode, which cannot set a CPU quota: the engine's --cpus 8 was dropped and every process started through docker exec was pinned to 8 CPUs by affinity (OCI execCPUAffinity) instead; memory and the GPU as the engine requested. The same value in the same steps as the native runs of the second round on the author's server (RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570, outside the engine): final1 on 87ad1f2d and final2 on dca001d1. Before the second round: 1.00000 through ale validate (validate-8d636430 and validate-42706a9b, the tree of cf31bdc / 51ea575) and natively on every tree since 8439170; 0.99440 on 15d8694, whose cell threw ejected fasteners out of their bins (tests/README.md, section 6).
note: mean_pack_credit is the mean over the hidden packs of the value of the components that lie undamaged where they belong over the value of everything in the pack (packcell/rules.py `credit`), already on [0, 1]; ratio = measured / value, reward = clamp(ratio / full_at, 0, 1). full_at 0.95: on the author's machine the reference repeats each pack step for step; the one spread measured is that of a small perturbation of its trajectory (the conversion change of 15d8694), which, with the cell's defect of then (fasteners thrown out of their bins, fixed in 8439170), moved mean_pack_credit from 1.00000 to 0.99440 (one pack by 2.7 %), and 0.95 leaves about nine times that. It leaves room for what another CPU may do to a contact-rich simulation (a fastener that ends outside a bin is 0.1 % of the metric, a module that is not racked 1.5 %). The validate run on a second host (another CPU and GPU) repeated every pack's steps; it has to be sized again from `ale validate` runs on the evaluation hosts.
